purpose: Say that a result holds regardless of how great a degree becomes.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
No matter how busy I am, I eat breakfast.
No matter how much I practice, I still get nervous.
However far away it is, I will go to see you.
restrictions: The degree is open-ended; the conclusion remains unchanged.
mistake: Use an adjective or verb that naturally varies in degree.
